top_keywords.example: Join an alliance to survive together
Freeze or fight — the choice is yours
Lead your people through the ice age
Upgrade your furnace to survive longer

creative_strategies.description: Opening with extreme weather or danger scenario to create urgency
Showing base evolution from small shelter to thriving settlement
Framing the player as a leader responsible for their people's survival
Showcasing large-scale alliance battles and PvP conflict

inferred_targeting_strategy.primary_audience: Male 25-40, strategy game players, survival genre fans
inferred_targeting_strategy.retargeting: Users of similar strategy games (Last War, Rise of Kingdoms, Frostpunk)
inferred_targeting_strategy.lookalike: Based on players who engage with survival-themed content

noteworthy_ads.body_preview: The temperature dropped to -40°C last night. Three of my people didn't make it. But we rebuilt. We got stronger. And now, we thrive.
noteworthy_ads.why_noteworthy: Uses emotional storytelling (loss + recovery) that creates strong emotional investment in first 5 seconds

noteworthy_ads.body_preview: While other chiefs are freezing, I'm building a heated fortress with a hospital, farm, and barracks. Here's my layout...
noteworthy_ads.why_noteworthy: Combines 'show off' mechanic with practical tips — drives high engagement from existing players too

noteworthy_ads.body_preview: Day 1: Tent. Day 7: Cabin. Day 30: Fortress. See what you can build in 30 days of Whiteout Survival.
noteworthy_ads.why_noteworthy: Carousel format perfectly matches the progression narrative, each swipe reveals the next stage

overall_assessment.strategy_focus: Whiteout Survival uses a dual-threat creative approach: the external threat (extreme weather) creates urgency, while the base-building progression provides a satisfying reward loop. The 'survival leader' narrative positions the player as a hero responsible for their community, which drives emotional investment.
overall_assessment.competitive_position: Direct competitor to Last War in the strategy survival genre. Differentiated through its unique ice-age theme and stronger emphasis on community/leadership narrative versus Last War's zombie/military focus.
